svg.title: From Signed NDAs to One Winning Buyer
svg.desc: diagram id: diag-02-competitive-deal-funnel; chapter number: 6; chart type: funnel; title: From Signed NDAs to One Winning Buyer; subtitle: The competitive process that sourced deal flow feeds; caption: Competition sets the price: a modified middle-market auction narrows signed NDAs to a single winner over four to eight months.; assumptions note: Stage counts are the round-number benchmarks POTOMAC M&A and other bankers describe; conversions are stated as counts, not measured percentages, and real processes vary by deal.; note: Source - POTOMAC M&A (8jBQ3jZnNvY): '10 IOIs from 50 NDAs is a really good day'.; stages: label: Signed NDAs; value: 50; display: Up to 50 NDAs; conversion: Top of the formal process; detail: Distribution to 30-40 PE firms plus 5-10 strategics, targeting 30-50 signed NDAs.; label: IOIs; value: 10; display: About 10 IOIs; conversion: 10 IOIs from 50 NDAs; detail: Absolute-price IOIs, not ranges, keep bids comparable.; label: Approved Bidders; value: 5; display: 5 approved bidders; conversion: 5 advanced from about 10 IOIs; detail: Pooled diligence and buyer-only deadlines keep pace.; label: Final Bids; value: 3; display: 3 final bids; conversion: 3 final bids from 5 bidders; detail: Escrow, R&W insurance, caps and baskets go into the LOI before exclusivity ends the competition.; label: One Winner; value: 1; display: 1 winner; conversion: 1 winner from 3 final bids; detail: The process runs four to eight months end to end.

text.title: From Signed NDAs to One Winning Buyer
text.tspan: From Signed NDAs to One Winning Buyer

rect.title: label: Signed NDAs; value: 50; display: Up to 50 NDAs; conversion: Top of the formal process; detail: Distribution to 30-40 PE firms plus 5-10 strategics, targeting 30-50 signed NDAs.
label: IOIs; value: 10; display: About 10 IOIs; conversion: 10 IOIs from 50 NDAs; detail: Absolute-price IOIs, not ranges, keep bids comparable.
label: Approved Bidders; value: 5; display: 5 approved bidders; conversion: 5 advanced from about 10 IOIs; detail: Pooled diligence and buyer-only deadlines keep pace.
label: Final Bids; value: 3; display: 3 final bids; conversion: 3 final bids from 5 bidders; detail: Escrow, R&W insurance, caps and baskets go into the LOI before exclusivity ends the competition.
label: One Winner; value: 1; display: 1 winner; conversion: 1 winner from 3 final bids; detail: The process runs four to eight months end to end.

text.title: Assumptions: Stage counts are the round-number benchmarks POTOMAC M&A and other bankers describe; conversions are stated as counts, not measured percentages, and real processes vary by deal.
text.tspan: Assumptions: Stage counts are the round-number benchmarks POTOMAC M&A and other bankers describe; conversions are stated as counts,
